div.div:
Protocol Requirements
1. The protocol shall allow a user to register a unique agent name in the format protocol://agentid.capability.provider.vVERSION
2. The protocol shall store one on-chain record per name, addressed by the SHA-256 hash of the full name
3. The protocol shall allow the owner to update the endpoint, transfer the name, or revoke it
4. The protocol shall keep a revoked name reserved so nobody else can impersonate it
5. The protocol shall require a minimum stake (SOL) to register, held inside the agent record
6. The protocol shall charge a registration fee, sent to the treasury
7. The protocol shall allow admin-approved verifiers to report challenge results (pass or fail)
8. The protocol shall slash a share of the stake (default 10%) to the treasury when a challenge fails
9. The protocol shall allow unstaking only after a cooldown, and keep a revoked name slashable during the cooldown
10. The protocol shall mark an endpoint as verified only after the agent proves it controls its key
11. The protocol shall allow an owner to list a name at a fixed price and anyone to buy it in one transaction
12. The protocol shall charge a sale fee (at most 10%), sent to the treasury; stake and reputation move with the name
13. The protocol shall serve name lookups through a resolver that signs every answer, with the signing key stored on-chain
14. The protocol shall index all on-chain events and show every agent's history in a public Explorer

div.div:
Steps
1 - Owner registers a name: the program checks the name rules and hash; the record is created and the stake is held inside it
2 - Fee goes to the treasury
3 - Verifier tests the agent endpoint and reports pass or fail on-chain
4 - On a fail the program takes 10% of the stake and clears the endpoint-verified flag
5 - Owner requests unstake; revoking a name does this automatically
6 - After the cooldown the owner withdraws the remaining stake

2 - Fee goes to the treasury

4 - On a fail the program takes 10% of the stake and clears the endpoint-verified flag
5 - Owner requests unstake; revoking a name does this automatically
6 - After the cooldown the owner withdraws the remaining stake
